We need count of aromatic carbons in the molecule. But we have no SMILES given. Possibly the sample is the compound at hand (the environment). We need to get its structure. Could use carbon_nmr_spectra? That gives spectra but not structure. Maybe we need to infer from NMR? But easier: maybe the system has a default sample? Not sure.

We could request carbon_nmr_spectra to see peaks; aromatic carbons appear around 120-150 ppm. Count peaks in that region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
